title: Jane Street七月巨亏150亿美元，AI押注成主要拖累
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Jane Street suffered roughly $15 billion in losses last month.
segments.zh: 简街上月亏损约150亿美元。

segments.en: It's first losing month and a decade. The hit came from its investment in AI-focused hedge fund situation awareness and wrong way bets in Asian equities.
segments.zh: 这是十年来首次月度亏损，主要源于对AI对冲基金的**失误及亚洲权益市场的错误押注。

segments.en: Despite the setback, Jane Street still has generated over $40 billion in trading revenue this year.
segments.zh: 尽管受挫，简街今年交易收入仍超400亿美元。

segments.en: For more on that story, Bloomberg Finance reporter who covered this, Catherine Doherty joins us now.
segments.zh: 彭博财经记者凯瑟琳·多尔蒂将为我们带来更多报道。

segments.en: Catherine, great to see you. So what exactly was behind the setback for them?
segments.zh: 凯瑟琳，很高兴见到你。他们受挫的具体原因是什么？

segments.en: So situational awareness is the primary headline driver for these losses.
segments.zh: 情境感知是这些损失的主要驱动因素。

segments.en: This is a company that is not just purely market making, moving in and out of positions.
segments.zh: 这家公司并非纯粹做市，频繁进出仓位。

segments.en: They have started to take investments over the long term hedge fund-like situational awareness.
segments.zh: 他们开始进行长期**，类似对冲基金的情境感知。

segments.en: The hedge fund, they had a stake in that. They are backing the founder.
segments.zh: 他们持有该对冲基金的股份，并支持其创始人。

segments.en: This is also a company that is backing many AI startups across the board.
segments.zh: 这家公司还广泛支持许多AI初创企业。

segments.en: So putting their money not just in the market as a trading firm, providing liquidity, but as a venture capital firm in a way, backing some of these new companies.
segments.zh: 因此，他们不仅作为交易公司提供流动性，还以类似风险**的方式，支持一些新兴企业。

segments.en: They have been really big in artificial intelligence infrastructure, helping chip makers, helping the data center builders, building their own data centers.
segments.zh: 他们在人工智能基础设施领域投入巨大，帮助芯片制造商和数据中心建设者，甚至自建数据中心。

segments.en: And so what you've seen today, in the month of July, the reported losses that the firm has had to deal with, and they have absorbed those losses.
segments.zh: 因此，在七月份，公司面临了报告中的亏损，但他们已经吸收了这些损失。
